evidence.title: Availability Scheduler · React motion component · beUI

name: Availability Scheduler
summary: Weekly availability editor React component with spring toggles, animated time ranges and a copy menu.
description: Free open-source React and Next.js motion component for editing weekly availability: each day springs between available and unavailable, time ranges add and remove with blur-slide motion, times come from a scrollable dropdown, and a copy menu clones hours to other days. Install with the shadcn CLI (shadcn add @beui/availability-scheduler) or copy the source; the API exposes value, onChange and a step prop for selectable-minute intervals.
contains: weekly availability editor with per-day available/unavailable toggles
time ranges animate in and out with blur-slide motion
scrollable time dropdowns with a configurable step (default 30 min)
copy menu clones one day's hours to other days
